mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, user_code, available_points, frozen_points, total_earned_points, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM points_wallet WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND user_code = #{userCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE points_wallet SET available_points = #{availablePoints}, frozen_points = #{frozenPoints}, total_earned_points = #{totalEarnedPoints}, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
